summary: Boise State beat Washington State 31-10 with a 21-0 fourth quarter. Jones earned a conference honor, while punt handling and penalty discipline remain work before Texas State visits Saturday night.

items.headline: Boise State pulls away for a 31-10 win
items.tldr: The Broncos scored 21 unanswered fourth-quarter points. Watch whether the offense can establish the same rushing rhythm before the game reaches its final period.

items.headline: Jones earns Pac-12 freshman of the week
items.tldr: The receiver returned to the offense against Washington State and received the conference honor Monday. Watch how his routes keep a passing answer available alongside the ground game.

items.headline: Punt handling and penalties leave avoidable risks
items.tldr: The On SI game report describes a muff recovered by a teammate and costly pass-interference flags. Keep possession security and coverage technique in view despite the comfortable final margin.
items.outlet: Boise State Broncos On SI via Yahoo

items.headline: Danielson credits the response after a difficult start
items.tldr: The postgame discussion focuses on how Boise State stayed in the game. Look for the repeatable blocking and decisions that can make the next opening possessions cleaner.

items.headline: Boise State shuts out Washington State in the fourth
items.tldr: The Cougars could not answer the late scoring run. Watch the defensive pursuit and coverage finish that keep a pressured quarterback from extending the possession.

lead.headline: Bring the finish to the opening drive.
lead.body: Make the first rushing lane and quick receiving answer work together. Preserve those possessions with secure punt handling, while the defense carries routes without giving away a flag.

matchup.thesis: Keep the ordinary play under control
matchup.question: What should fans watch in the next game?
matchup.answer: Take the blocked running lane or the clean first throw before extending the down. Finish defensive coverage with leverage and disciplined contact so a stop remains a stop.

signals.title: Rushing rhythm
signals.detail: Watch the block at the point of attack and the runner’s first cut. Establish a reliable carry before asking the offense to wait for the long breakaway.

signals.title: Receiving outlets
signals.detail: Use the receiver’s release and route spacing to offer a quick completion. A useful passing answer should support the run game when the defense crowds the line.

signals.title: Punt handling
signals.detail: Set the returner’s decision and communication before the catch. A safe possession is the first job when the coverage closes the return lane.

signals.detail: Carry the receiver with controlled leverage and locate the ball before contact. Do not let a difficult third down become an automatic first down through a flag.
